caption: The drawing features three views of a circular object with intricate designs. At the top, there is a fully colored, detailed rendering of the object: it is circular with scalloped edges and decorated with ornate, swirling leaf-like patterns in shades of brown, gold, white, and black. At the center of this object, there is an oval section that contains a depiction of a small house or building with a tree, bordered by an oval frame. Below this, on the left, is a line drawing of the front of the same object, showing the same scalloped circular shape, ornamental scrollwork, and an arrangement of five parallel vertical bars at the center. On the right, there is a line drawing of the object's side view, displaying its curved edge and a portion of the pattern. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional elements present.
title: Comb
